PDF The Magic Volume Lens: An Interactive Focus+Context Technique for ...
To achieve interactive focus+context volume rendering, we have implemented all of our volumetric lenses on contemporary graphic hardware. In GPU-accelerated ray casting volume rendering [14], front faces and back faces of the volume bounding box are drawn using OpenGL in two fragment passes to get the start and end points for all the rays.
